# Releases

This directory is reserved for release notes and manifests related to **our** tested comparison/port artifacts.

Do not place an upstream binary or source archive here unless its license explicitly permits redistribution and attribution requirements are satisfied.

When this comparison reaches a reproducible milestone, record at least:

- release/version name;
- source commit;
- tested board marking;
- Arduino ESP32 core version;
- library/BSP version;
- build settings;
- test result;
- artifact checksum;
- relationship to the upstream revision.

For ordinary repository-wide Arduino BSP releases, prefer the existing `arduino-v*` release flow rather than duplicating the same ZIP here.
